items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: And I couldn't understand why Willy and them was living in the hotel paying $35.00 a day... Some of them cats in the band was going crazy ---happy.

ctx.x: Yes. Alexandria. And this band had all its friends, and everything. So I said, give me "Stardust". I jumped out there and I did a little Armstrong, got up there and did "Stardust" and hit the notes on the end (inaudible) and that broke the house open. It broke it open and then it was beautiful. Oh, it was beautiful. And I couldn't understand why Willy and them was living in the hotel paying $35.00 a day. But the man was so proud he says, "I own all the bread, I own all the ice cream. I own all the dope." So I…
So it seems like the man told us, I pay my musicians 50 pounds a day. So after that (inaudible). And that man was laying something on me like 10 pounds a day.
